statement: A query contains at least one positive binary fact relation, no more than 64 total clauses, and every builtin variable is bound by a fact relation; unsupported or unbounded syntax is rejected before evaluation.

frames.note: Parses Datalog source before sending the request.
Tokenizes and parses only the supported relation and builtin forms.
Requires a positive fact relation, enforces the clause bound, and checks builtin variables are bound.

consequence: The evaluator receives a bounded query AST rather than unsupported syntax or unbound constraint work.
